div.head: Ps Cn for 22
div.ab: Si liberalis aliquis feram foreste fugerit, siue casu siue prehabita uoluntate, ita ut cursu celeri cogatur fera anhelare, decem solidos regi emendet; si illiberalis, dupliciter emendet; si seruus, careat corio.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 624 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: If any noble chases a beast of the forest, whether by chance or with premeditated will, so that the beast is made to pant by the swift running, let him pay the king ten shillings compensation; if a non-noble, let him pay double compensation; if a slave, let him lose his hide.
